Tokens. Inputs (Q4 a), on body in custom.scss beside --gamecult-wash: --gamecult-nebula-0/1/2 ("255 138 42", "109 96 255", "89 183 255") and --gamecult-nebula-base (#07111a). Outputs with seeds, on :root: --gamecult-ground-0/1/2 (#03070d #07111a #09141f), and for N in 0..2 --gamecult-light-N (rgb triple), -a (0.18/0.16/0.14), -at ("78% 14%"/"18% 10%"/"52% 0%"), -r (18%/24%/28%), plus --gamecult-ground-mean (#07111a). The body background becomes radial-gradient(circle at var(--gamecult-light-0-at), rgb(var(--gamecult-light-0) / calc(var(--gamecult-light-0-a) * var(--gamecult-wash))), transparent var(--gamecult-light-0-r)) x3 over linear-gradient(180deg, var(--gamecult-ground-0) 0%, var(--gamecult-ground-1) 44%, var(--gamecult-ground-2) 100%).

Ritual essays: their seeds go under :root:has(body[data-slug="Blog/..."]) for the three slugs (yellow 255 178 30 .15 at 78% 8% 24rem; cobalt 49 88 255 .22 at 18% 4% 30rem; violet 91 54 184 .19 at 44% 20% 34rem; stops #030414 0%, #070b24 42%, #040514 100%; nebula inputs likewise overridden to yellow/cobalt/violet and base #050614). The ritual block's own background declaration is deleted; it inherits body's.

ground.js owns: WebGL2 context on #gamecult-ground (alpha:false, antialias:false, powerPreference 'low-power'); capability check (WebGL2, EXT_color_buffer_half_float or float); input token read via getComputedStyle(document.body) -> uniforms; the flow texture pass (quarter res, RG16F, two snoise per texel, once per frame); the march pass; the TAA resolve with reprojection; the 8x8 downsample and the async PBO readback; the token writer on document.documentElement.style; the scheduler (30 fps cadence, visibilityState pause, reduced-motion freeze and stop at 32 frames); the budget controller; the debug flag (?ground=debug) and parity flags.

Sampled wash: after the resolve, draw the final frame into an 8x8 RGBA8 target; gl.readPixels into a PIXEL_PACK_BUFFER; gl.fenceSync; on later frames poll getSyncParameter(SYNC_STATUS) and only when SIGNALED call getBufferSubData. Never readPixels to client memory directly (that stalls). At most 2 Hz. Compute the token values as the map states (row means for the stops; light colour and excess at the seed light's centre texel; the mean for --gamecult-ground-mean) and write them with setProperty on :root only when a value moved by more than 1/255. Q5 (a): keep the last written set in sessionStorage under one key and apply it on load before the first frame; it is a cache, and a missing or malformed entry means the seeds.

Budget controller, one function, one state machine: GPU time per frame by EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 when present, else a fenceSync after the resolve polled to completion, else rAF cadence. Over a 60-frame window: if the median exceeds the budget (4.0 ms), step down: S 16 -> 8 -> 4, then dpr -> 1 (Q2), then remove the canvas (the seeds paint). Never step up within a session. A median rising 50% over 5 minutes also steps down. No storage of the verdict, no userAgent, no maxTouchPoints.

cloud.frag.glsl: #version 300 es; precision highp float; precision highp int; the vendored CultMath.glsl is concatenated by ground.js before this file's body. The field, warp, interval march (ball radius F0 * (Δ/2 + D) with D = FLOW_MAX * PERIOD / 2) and integration exactly as the map's pseudocode; hue from the flow texture's channels mixed over the three nebula inputs; uniforms: resolution, time, dt, frame, jitter, S, intensity, nebula colours, base, Z0/Z1, F0, CUTOFF, K, PERIOD, FLOW_MAX. flow.frag.glsl: the two low-frequency snoise. taa.frag.glsl: motion vector from the flow texture (mv = project(-flow * dt)), history fetched at uv - mv, 3x3 min/max clamp, alpha = max(1/frames, 1/32), out-of-bounds alpha 1; writes new history and the screen (luminance clamp 0.035) via drawBuffers or two draws.

Vendoring (D3): site/quartz/static/ground/CultMath.glsl byte-equal to CultLib shaders/CultMath.glsl at the commit named in its first line. scripts/ground/check-cultmath-glsl.ps1 diffs it against git show <sha>:packages/cultmath/shaders/CultMath.glsl from a CultLib checkout and exits non-zero on drift.

Parity on the device: with ?ground=parity, ground.js evaluates the vendored fixture (CultLib tests/CultMath.Tests/fixtures/glsl-parity.json) one pixel per point, reads back float bit patterns, and reports per function the max ulp distance and the count outside its tolerance class. With ?ground=parity-wash, density and stardust are forced to 0 and the flow frozen; the canvas must equal the CSS seed wash within 2/255 at 16 points on / and on a ritual essay (this pins that the seed values and the shader's base agree at zero density, which is what the fallback promises).

Prove in the browser pane: max relative luminance after 32 frames on / at intensity 1 (<= 0.035); the parity-wash probe; the debug readback (mean evals per pixel, unfinished-ray fraction < 1%); the token writer (after 2 s on /, :root's inline style carries all fifteen tokens and --gamecult-ground-mean, each within the expected range, and getComputedStyle(body).backgroundImage resolves to the sampled values); the motion test (with ?ground=debug-mv the resolve writes |mv| into red: non-zero where flow is non-zero, zero under reduced motion); GPU ms per pass with the timer query at the pane's desktop size and at the mobile preset's pixel count. Phone GPU time is operator verification.

authority_map.owner: The shader owns the ground. custom.scss owns the four nebula inputs, --gamecult-wash and the seed values; ground.js owns the flow texture, the march, the TAA, the readback and the sampled ground tokens on :root; CultLib owns every noise and interval function the field calls.
inputs: the four nebula tokens and --gamecult-wash (computed on body)
prefers-reduced-motion, visibilityState, canvas size, devicePixelRatio, elapsed time
measured GPU frame time (timer query, fence, or rAF cadence)
the vendored CultMath.glsl at its pinned CultLib commit
outputs: one opaque moving canvas under the page, luminance <= 0.035
the fifteen ground tokens and --gamecult-ground-mean on :root inline, at most 2 Hz
debug and parity readbacks (console, flag only)
derived_state: the ground tokens are derived from the shader's result while it runs; the seeds are the fallback; the CSS wash renders whichever is in force; the shader never reads them
the flow texture is the one owner of motion: warp, hue, motion vectors (and the stardust, next cut) read it
the TAA history is a cache, reprojected by the flow; reset on resize, first frame and budget step
S and dpr are derived from measurement within the session; never stored
the sessionStorage token set is a cache of the last sample; absent or malformed means seeds
CultMath.glsl in the site is derived from CultLib at the pinned commit
forbidden_writers: no colour, alpha, position or radius literal in ground.js or any GLSL file
no read of --gamecult-ground-* or --gamecult-light-* by the shader or by ground.js, except the seed read before the first readback
no navigator.userAgent, platform, maxTouchPoints, or any device-name branch
no class or attribute set on body or html by ground.js; token writes are setProperty on :root only
no second wash token; no page rule setting a radial alpha; no second flow evaluation outside flow.frag.glsl
no noise or interval function defined in the site's GLSL; only cultmath_* calls
no synchronous readPixels to client memory; no setInterval; one requestAnimationFrame scheduler; localStorage never
shared_paths: home, every content page and the ritual essays paint one canvas and one token set, in CSS and in the shader
slow device, hidden tab, reduced motion, missing WebGL2 and missing half-float all pass through the one controller
the 8x8 readback is the only path from the shader to CSS; the beforeDOMLoaded cache apply and the live writer set the same tokens the same way
the same Deploy Quartz workflow; static files ship with the overlay
